decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted herewith (Perspective photo,  Planning/Design and Access Statement, Drawing Numbers 3777 ARCH P150, P151, P152, P153, P154, P155, P250, P251A, P252A, P253A, P254, P255A, 4685 010, received 14/06/12)and approved by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is occupied).  Any applications for variation shall be accompanied, inter alia, by overlay drawings provided by the applicant for comparison with the permitted scheme.

Condition : 3 - The rating level of any noise generated by plant & equipment as part of the 	development shall be at least 10 dB below the pre-existing background level 	as determined by BS4142: 1997- "Method of rating industrial noise affecting 	mixed residential and industrial areas".

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 08.00 to 18.00 on Mondays to Fridays and none shall take place on weekends and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Extension of roof top plant enclosure: Installation of diesel fuel storage tank and roof top telecommunications equipment.
